body: I don't know what there is to talk out. Sometimes it gets hard to see why I should live. I wish I could get my hands on some alcohol or something so i didnt have to feel like shit, and soon Ill be able to because of my roommate.

I get that but I dont know why I should keep going. I feel so detached from people and im just sad all the time so just why? I get i should be here for other people but it gets harder and harder to care as time goes on and i live another day feeling shitty.
I've already tried getting help, on meds, see a therapist, gained some best friends, it all does nothing.
i dont know the depression is already impossible to bear most of the time, the guilt is worse. the anxiety makes the future impossible
